<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- the SDK route bridge reached **69** of **252** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **183** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **183**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **124** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **181** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f9fda2a4f84f2b49a7c14f1a994788ee76f13c73` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `f51c93b5ca1a7aa179ea3d43203b7b87234aa63e` — the merge of head `8c569968e24d85be4bcf7d819effe3d4db4ebdf2` into base `f9fda2a4f84f2b49a7c14f1a994788ee76f13c73`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin f51c93b5ca1a7aa179ea3d43203b7b87234aa63e && git checkout f51c93b5ca1a7aa179ea3d43203b7b87234aa63e
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin f9fda2a4f84f2b49a7c14f1a994788ee76f13c73 8c569968e24d85be4bcf7d819effe3d4db4ebdf2 && git checkout -B drift-repro f9fda2a4f84f2b49a7c14f1a994788ee76f13c73 && git merge --no-ff 8c569968e24d85be4bcf7d819effe3d4db4ebdf2

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f9fda2a4f84f2b49a7c14f1a994788ee76f13c73
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs f9fda2a4f84f2b49a7c14f1a994788ee76f13c73` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `076ed68671c72dfd944d9b365b4d4f6c3b1fd590`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts, skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md + packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts, ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts, ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionEngine.ts, ui/packages/react/src/context/ActionContext.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/{useAskAiHandler,useAiSurface,surfaceAgent}.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/DeclaredActionsBar.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ConsoleShell.tsx, the twelve renderer files under ui/packages/components, plugin-grid and plugin-detail, .changeset/37142-ask-ai-action-type.md; read as context, not in the diff: objectViewHeaderLaunchGate.tsx, RelatedRecordActionsBridge.tsx, ObjectGrid.tsx bulk dispatch, resolveBulkActions.ts, chatFocus.ts, AiChatPage.tsx, pr-automation.yml level rule
Security-touching: yes
Rule-change-verified: none

### ① Derived judgments
- **Spec member: met.** `ask_ai` is outside `TARGET_REQUIRED_TYPES`, through the new `TARGETLESS_TYPES`. `refuseAskAiContradictions` refuses `target` at `target`, and `ai.exposed: true` at `ai.exposed`, on both `ActionSchema` and `InlineActionSchema`. The member and its executor land in one PR.
- **Headless: met.** `isHeadlessInvokableAction` falls through to `false` for `ask_ai`, so `list_actions`, `run_action` and the `action_` family do not serve it.
- **No message, no server call: met.** `executeAskAi` only calls the installed handler, which is `setChatFocus` plus `dock.open()`. Nothing posts to the chat endpoint or starts a flow.
- **Absent without the assistant: met.** Every surface that reads `isActionSwitchedOff` also reads the draw gate, except `form.tsx` and `managedByEmptyState.ts`, which the PR names. With no handler, the action is not drawn, rather than drawn disabled.
- **"No single record ⇒ absent": not met.** See R1 and R2.
- **Dashboard header refusal: justified.** A header has no record and no selection, so every click would be refused. It follows the `refuseUnopenableHeaderActionUrl` precedent, and it narrows nothing, because on main the enum already rejected `ask_ai`.
- **SQL push-down:** n/a.

### ② Semver level
- `Clause-②: yes` (widening) and `Metadata-protocol: added` are correct.
- spec, core, react and app-shell are `minor`; runtime, components, plugin-grid and plugin-detail are `patch`. The patch packages gain no export and no authorable key.
- `Check Changeset` is green.

### ③ Boundary flags
- **Security.** The focus `{ object, id }` comes from a row, page record or selection the client already holds. It is advisory: per ADR-0160 D6, the server re-reads the record as the caller. No path widens what a user can read.
- **MCP.** No headless surface serves the action, and `ai.exposed: true` is refused at parse.
- **Generated artifacts.** Only `content/docs/references/**` moves. The regeneration gates are still running.
- **SKILL.md.** One row added (+138 bytes). The token ratchet is not finished.
- **CI.** 66 check-runs: 19 success, 9 skipped, 38 in progress, 0 failed. The verdict rests on R1 and R2, not on CI.

### ④ Design judgment
The spec half and the absent-not-disabled draw gate are sound and well tested. The gap is on the three surfaces that hold no single record. There the action is drawn, and then it is disabled, behaves wrongly without saying so, or points at the parent record.

### Findings
- **R1 (must-fix): multi-select pins a record instead of being absent.** `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/components/BulkActionBar.tsx:111-115`, `ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts:3051-3068`.
  - A list view's `bulkActions` may name an `ask_ai` action. The per-record bulk dispatcher runs it once per selected row, with `_rowRecord` set.
  - `askAiFocus` reads that row, so the "several selected" refusal is never reached. The handler fires N times, the last row stays pinned, and the result panel counts N successes.
  - Fix: leave `ask_ai` out of the bulk item set, refuse a bulk dispatch in the runner, and add a test.
- **R2 (must-fix): `list_toolbar` draws it disabled, not absent.** `ActionRunner.ts:2044-2051`, via `objectViewHeaderLaunchGate.tsx:47-57`. With zero or several rows selected, the list header shows the button greyed out with a reason. The card's acceptance says absent, and the maintainer's note of 2026-11-25 added that line. Make it absent wherever no single record is held.
- **R3 (should-fix): the draw gate is wider than the pin control's.** `surfaceAgent.ts:100-102`, `useAskAiHandler.ts:38`. The gate holds when any catalog agent has `capabilities.focus`, but the pin control (`AiChatPage.tsx:2070`) asks the active agent. D7 draws the action "only under the condition it draws the pin control".
- **R4 (should-fix): a related-list toolbar `ask_ai` focuses the parent record.** `RelatedRecordActionsBridge.tsx:713-716`. This is another surface with no single record, as in R2.
- **R5 (should-fix): Skills-docs line form.** It now reads `follow-up owed — …`. The card is filed as #37217, so the line should read `Skills-docs: follow-up #37217` in the PR body and in the changeset.
- **R6 (nit).** `recordIdField` is honoured on the row and selected-row paths but not the page-record path (`ActionRunner.ts:3058-3066`).
- **R7 (nit).** The SKILL.md row (:151) omits the dashboard-header refusal. Optional.

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `159f98ccad82bdd78a29192d98776670634c57ec`
Local-runs: none
Scope: delta from 076ed686, the PR's own commits f003d0ed, c0f94176, 15af54ac, 6740772a, 7a6b50db, 159f98cc; plus the PR face of the first review's Scope files across merges 15513b8b and 5671abd1; read as context: ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/chatFocus.ts

2026-11-25T09:58Z — delta read after the FAIL at `076ed686`. All six earlier findings are met, but the R3 fix introduces one new must-fix (N1).

### Prior findings
- **R1 — met.** `BulkActionBar.tsx:117-118` leaves `ask_ai` out of the bulk set. `ObjectGrid.tsx:2933-2934` refuses it through the new `ActionRunner.bulkRefusal`. `ActionEngine.ts:317` and `:367-369` exclude it as well. Covered by `BulkActionBar.askAi-37142.test.tsx`.
- **R2 — met.** `objectViewHeaderLaunchGate.tsx:55-58` draws the button only when exactly one row is selected. Covered by its test.
- **R3 — met as asked.** The handler opens the drawer on a `capabilities.focus` agent, with `ask` first (`surfaceAgent.ts:111-114`, `useAskAiHandler.ts:46-47`). See N1.
- **R4 — met.** `RelatedList.tsx:1587` filters `ask_ai` out of the toolbar. `record-related-list.tsx` feeds the same prop, so it is covered too. Covered by `RelatedList.toolbarAskAi-37142.test.tsx`.
- **R5 — met.** The PR body and the changeset both read `Skills-docs: follow-up #37217`.
- **R6 — met.** The page-record path in `askAiFocus` now reads `recordIdField`.
- **R7 — deferred to #37217. Accepted:** it was a nit.

### Merge sanity
Across both merges, the PR face of the first review's Scope files is unchanged: 19 files, +248 −35. The added and removed lines hash the same at `076ed686` and `159f98cc`.

### Findings in the delta
- **N1 (must-fix): with the drawer open on another conversation, the click pins the conversation being left.** `useAskAiHandler.ts:46-47`.
  - The handler calls `setChatFocus` and then `open({ agent })`.
  - When the mounted host already shows a conversation id, `handOff` (`chatFocus.ts:242`) sets no carry. The focus is therefore written to the conversation on screen.
  - `open({ agent })` then moves the drawer to the agent's own conversation. `useConversationFocus` (`chatFocus.ts:190-200`) reads that conversation's stored focus, which is empty.
  - The result: no chip, no focus on the turn, and a stray pin left on the conversation the user moved away from.
  - This happens whenever the open drawer shows something other than the target agent's conversation, for example the app-bound build thread.
  - The fix order is to switch the agent first and then hand off, or to hand the focus to `open` itself. Add a test with a mounted host on another conversation; the current test mocks both sides, so it cannot see this.
- **N2 (nit).** The Skills-docs line dropped "updated here", but `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` still changes in this PR.
- **N3 (nit).** `bulkRefusal` refuses on type alone, ignoring a host-registered `ask_ai` handler. `refusalBeforeInput` steps aside for one. No effect today, because the console registers none.
- **No finding:** the showcase action `showcase_ask_about_task` (record_header, no target, no `ai` block), the `ActionEngine` narrowing, and the two action-type tables.

### Declarations and CI
`Clause-②: yes`, `Metadata-protocol: added` and the changeset levels are unchanged and still correct. CI on `159f98cc`: 61 success, 9 skipped, 0 failed, 0 pending.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `76f9cdab6ad3334c1e5438da6740969d1f202845`
Local-runs: none
Scope: delta from 159f98cc, commit 76f9cdab: ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useAskAiHandler.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/chatFocus.ts, ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts, .changeset/37142-ask-ai-action-type.md, content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx, two test files; read as context: ChatDockConversation.tsx, useChatConversation.ts (`forceNew`), chatDockTarget.ts, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md:321
Security-touching: yes
Rule-change-verified: none

2026-11-25T10:42Z — second delta read, after FAIL 7159069237 at `159f98cc`. N1 is fixed. The spec face is unchanged, so R1–R6 still hold as met.

### ① Derived judgments
- **N1 — fixed.** The handler now calls `open({ agent, fresh: true })` and then `setChatFocus(focus, { follow: true })` (`useAskAiHandler.ts:49-50`).
  - **Drawer open on another conversation** (the app-bound build thread included) or on the target's own thread: `fresh` sets `forceNew` (`useChatConversation.ts:1072-1075`), which blanks the id. The key always moves from the old id to undefined, and the follow lands there with carry. The conversation the user left keeps its own focus.
  - **Unsent thread or closed drawer:** the focus is taken at once, or held as pending for the host that mounts.
  - The new block in `chatFocus-36999.test.tsx` runs against the real `ChatDockConversation`, `useConversationFocus` and `useAskAiHandler`.
- **`follow` does not leak.** A pending follow lives in the dock host's state and unmounts with the drawer. It could only hang if the key stayed unchanged, and `fresh` always changes a defined key. `setFocus` and `decline` on the chip drop it.
- **Fresh thread vs ADR-0160 D7:** not contradicted, since nothing is created until the first send. It does go past D7's "same path as the pin control": every click now opens a new conversation. That is reversible console behaviour with no schema impact, and it goes to the maintainer as a product question. It does not hold the verdict.

### ② Semver level
Unchanged and correct: `Clause-②: yes`, `Metadata-protocol: added`. spec, core, react and app-shell are `minor` (the new `setChatFocus` option is in app-shell); the rest are `patch`.

### ③ Boundary flags
- **Security:** the focus is still the record the click ran on, reported by the client and re-read as the caller. The change only decides which conversation holds it.
- **CI on `76f9cdab`:** 62 success, 11 skipped, 0 failed. One `PR-body guards` run was cancelled; it had been superseded by a later run, which passed.

### Findings
- **N4 (should-fix, non-blocking; follow-up card):** until the fresh thread gets an id, it holds the record with carry (`chatFocus.ts:215-230`). If the user picks a history conversation instead of sending, that conversation takes the record and its stored focus is overwritten. The carry rule predates this PR; the fresh thread only widens the window. The chip stays visible and removable.
- **N2 — withdrawn.** `Skills-docs: follow-up #37217` is the right form: `updated here` is reserved for `domain:skills` PRs (pm-dispatch SKILL.md:321).
- **N3 — accepted.** The type-only bulk refusal is documented at `ActionRunner.ts:2041-2043`.

## 维护者速读
这个 PR 让应用作者可以给记录配一个「问 AI」按钮。点下去，助手面板会打开，并带上这条记录作为话题，但不会替用户发出任何消息。如果当前没有支持记录话题的助手，按钮就不显示。按钮只出现在「恰好一条记录」的位置：选了多行、列表表头没选中、关联列表工具栏这些地方都不显示。合同评审（fable 档）做了三轮，最后一轮通过。
要你做的：这个 PR 改了受管文件（平台界面技能），需要你在 head `76f9cdab` 上点批准或亲自入队。另外有一个产品取舍要你定：现在每次点「问 AI」都会新开一个对话。我会另外单独问你。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT (L1) · repo:objectstack#1 · head `76f9cdab` · 2026-11-25T10:43Z

- **Shape:** #37142 (topic #36996 row 6). +1,703 −113 across 60 files. Tier H because of `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md`; no size limb. `Clause-②: yes`, `Metadata-protocol: added`.
- **Contract review:** CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER PASS 7160086862 at this head. Earlier rounds: FAIL at `076ed686` (R1–R7) and FAIL 7159069237 at `159f98cc` (N1). R1–R6 and N1 are closed and each is pinned by a test. R7 rides #37217.
- **Owed follow-up:** N4. An unsent fresh thread's carry can land on a history conversation the user picks before sending. This is should-fix and non-blocking; the #37142 thread files the card.
- **Product question to the maintainer:** should "ask AI" always start a new conversation, or pin to the one on screen? It is reversible console behaviour, and it does not hold the landing.
- **Gates:** on `76f9cdab`, 62 success, 11 skipped, 0 failed. One `PR-body guards` run was cancelled; a later run superseded it and passed.
- **Landing:** Tier H, so this is handed to the maintainer. It lands after his approval at this head, or he enqueues it himself. Any further push needs a delta read.
No must-fix open.
